text:
Four beakers containing equal volumes of water at 10°C are placed outside in full sunshine on a
hot day.
The four beakers are identical except for their surface colour and texture.
Which beaker will heat up the quickest?
A
B
C
D
dull black
shiny black
dull white
shiny white
subject: Physics
